project_name: EP SEO Audit - For Excellent Publicity
category: Enterprise SEO & Core Web Vitals Platform
description: EP SEO Audit streamlines the auditing process into three distinct, friction-free phases: Domain Discovery with a headless, render-aware crawler, Multi-Surface Scoring against 250+ SEO signals, and Unified Report Delivery that generates a clean report with precise engineering fixes.
how_it_works: Domain Discovery: System deploys a headless, render-aware crawler that respects robots.txt rules and map graphs, ensuring it scans exactly what Googlebot sees.
Multi-Surface Scoring: Runs a comprehensive pass checking 250+ SEO signals simultaneously against modern search standards.
Unified Report Delivery: Merges findings into a centralized, severity-prioritized dashboard. Generates a clean report detailing where an issue sits alongside an exact engineering fix.
problem_it_solves: Friction between SEO needs and coding implementation, outdated tools that ignore AI search overviews, and subscription fatigue from disjointed SEO platforms.
solution: Unifies everything into a single ecosystem, giving stakeholders an easily digestible overview. It bridges the gap between SEO and Engineering with ready-to-paste fixes and future-proofs sites for LLM overviews.
business_benefits: Bridges the Gap Between SEO & Engineering: Provides evidence screenshots, highlights specific failing code elements, and gives developers ready-to-paste fixes for backlogs like Linear.
Future-Proofs Against AI Search Overviews: Optimizes site to ensure it is indexable and citable by LLMs, conversational engines, and AI summary interfaces (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews).
Saves Time and Tool Creep: Unifies multiple tools (speed, local maps, schemas, etc.) into a single ecosystem.
key_features: Technical SEO & Crawlability: JS-Rendered HTML Diffing, canonical error tracking, and sitemap parities
Core Web Vitals & Performance: Real Field Data (CrUX) tracking and INP/LCP Attribution Maps
Rich Schema Validation: Automatic JSON-LD generation and eligibility audits against native validator hooks
E-E-A-T & Content Optimization: Entity Coverage scanning and Thin Content Detection
Local SEO & Maps: Geo-Grid Tracking and cross-platform NAP Consistency Engines
AI Search & Optimization (GEO): LLM Compliance checks (llms.txt) and passage-level Citation Readiness
unique_value: Eliminates the struggle of translating SEO needs into code while preparing websites for both traditional algorithms and conversational AI search engines.
future_scope: Integration with more third-party analytics services

description: PixStock is a comprehensive asset management platform built for product teams requiring predictable media storage and fast delivery. Designed with a developer-first approach, it automates asset ingestion and lifecycle tasks while offering a suite of specialized APIs to dynamically generate developer showcases, branded SVG grids, and high-quality stock imagery.
problem_it_solves: Product teams and developers often lack a predictable, dedicated infrastructure for media storage and dynamic generation of developer-specific visual assets (like repo cards and tech stack icons).
solution: Provides a developer-friendly API prioritizing fast media delivery and automation, along with specialized endpoints for dynamically generating custom SVG profiles and resolving stock media.
key_features: Predictable Asset Infrastructure with stable identifiers
Developer-first API for optimized asset delivery
Automated asset ingestion and lifecycle management
GitHub Stats API for dynamic profile stat cards
Pin API for rendering repository showcase cards
Tech Stack Icons API for branded SVG icon grids
Animal & Vehicle APIs for high-quality stock imagery resolution
unique_value: Developer-centric platform merging robust media infrastructure with targeted APIs that generate dynamic, high-quality visuals for developer profiles and product pages.
my_role_and_learnings: Architected both the backend API infrastructure and the user-facing documentation. Deepened understanding of scalable API design, dynamic image generation (SVGs), and creating developer-centric tools with clean, accessible documentation.
future_scope: Expansion of dynamic image generation tools
Enhanced user dashboard for asset management
